description: This Java interface defines data access methods for the Provider entity in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying Provider objects, their attributes, roles, and related information, facilitating database interactions for provider management.

classes.name: ProviderDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for Provider, defining methods to manage Provider entities in the database.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Provider objects, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves or updates a Provider entity in the database.

methods.name: deleteProvider
methods.description: Deletes a specified Provider from the database.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its internal integer ID.

methods.name: getProviderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Fetches providers associated with a given Person object, including options to include retired providers.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Fetches a list of providers matching specified name and attribute criteria, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Returns the count of providers matching specific name and retirement status filters.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all provider attribute types, with an option to include retired types.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ProviderAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Finds a ProviderAttributeType using its UUID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Finds a ProviderAttributeType by its name.

methods.name: saveProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a specified ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: getProviderAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Finds a ProviderAttribute by its UUID.

methods.name: isProviderIdentifierUnique
methods.description: Checks whether the Provider's identifier is unique in the database.

methods.name: getProviderByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its unique identifier string.

methods.name: getProviderRole
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderRole by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderRole by UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles
methods.description: Retrieves Providers associated with specified roles, including retired ones if specified.

methods.name: getAllProviderRoles
methods.description: Fetches all ProviderRoles, optionally including retired roles.

methods.name: saveProviderRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderRole.

methods.name: deleteProviderRole
methods.description: Deletes a specific ProviderRole.
